sources.quote: DeepSeek API prices drop 50%+, effective immediately.
sources.supports: The provider explicitly announced a real API price reduction that took effect immediately.

sources.quote: Date: 2025-09-29 DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp Both deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner have been upgraded to DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp. deepseek-chat corresponds to DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp's non-thinking mode
sources.supports: The provider's changelog dates the model upgrade to September 29, 2025 and identifies deepseek-chat as the upgraded API model.

notes: Classified as a provider price change: DeepSeek's release note says the reduction was effective immediately, and its changelog dates the deepseek-chat upgrade to 2025-09-29. The source states no time of day, so precision is day; no official previous-price figure is asserted here. Internet Archive CDX returned HTTP 503, so no archived pricing-page snapshots could be checked.
